verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26293887 from Karton Nowak to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318775 (2026-10-26). One line: item 00020, CMP-GAM-004 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 (USK/PEGI), 20,000 pcs at 0.06 EUR, confirmed for 2026-11-21. Printed to artwork rev. C. Dispatch 2026-11-21 via Warta Trans, delivery to DC Hamburg the same evening. DAP Hamburg, NET30.
red_flags: Confirmed delivery date is 2026-11-21, with dispatch and delivery to Hamburg both on the same day, so there is no transit buffer.
Supplier states printing is to artwork rev. C received 2026-08-07; the buyer should check that rev. C is the currently approved artwork revision.
No document date is shown on the confirmation.
observations: Typed PDF, single page, no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
Quantity unit is not stated; the unit price basis (per piece or per 1,000) is not stated.
Order confirmation has no document date; only the PO date 2026-10-26 is given.
